name: Kylie Johnson
source:
Kylie is the youngest of the two sisters, and knows first hand what it's like to be on the receiving end of parental abuse. She has become somewhat a recluse as she continually deals with what she has gone through. Perhaps a past connection might help heal her.

[From [url=https://jun1or72.itch.io/lost-found]Itch.io[/url]]
